sources.title: Danelectro Nichols 1966 Pedal Review - Premier Guitar
sources.excerpt: Danelectro Nichols 1966 Review A technicolor swirl of distortion, drive, boost, and ferocious fuzz. Jul 16, 2024 Danelectro Nichols 1966 4.2 Tones Build Design Ease of use Value Street: $199 Pros: Summons a wealth of engaging, and often unique, boost, drive, distortion, and fuzz tones that deviate from common templates. Interactive controls. Cons: Finding just-right tones, while rewarding, might demand patience from less assured and experienced drive-pedal users. Tone control could be more nuanced.
